# routeros_system_package_update (Resource)
Settings of `/system package update`: the update channel and how the router reaches the MikroTik update servers. The resource only changes settings; it never checks for, downloads or installs updates. Deleting it only removes it from the state.

## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_system_package_update" "this" {
  channel = "long-term"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `channel` (String) Release channel the router checks for updates (`development`, `long-term`, `stable`, `testing`). Changing the channel does not install anything by itself.
- `check_certificate` (Boolean) Verify the certificate of the update server (`mode = "https"`).
- `ip_version` (String) IP protocol used to reach the update server (`auto`, `ipv4`, `ipv6`).
- `mode` (String) Protocol used to download the update information and packages (`http`, `https`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `installed_version` (String) Currently installed RouterOS version.
- `latest_version` (String) Latest version available in the selected channel. Known only after a successful `/system package update check-for-updates`.
- `status` (String) Result of the last update check (as printed by RouterOS).

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
terraform import routeros_system_package_update.this .
```
